In the throwaway probe clone I appended the forms below, one block at a time, to packages/shared/src/formula/parse.ts and separately to packages/shared/src/value.ts. After each block I ran ESLint and the fuzz.test.ts source scan, then restored the file. Block (a) holds 14 round-6 forms in my own spellings. Generators: a declaration with finally-yield, an object method, a class method, an expression with yield*, and a generator whose finally returns plus it.return(). Names: then/catch/finally as a destructured name, a string key, a template, a #private name, a thenable { then() } and a key. Asynchronous sources: Array.fromAsync, [Symbol.asyncIterator] and ['fromAsync']. Block (b) holds the 17 round-5 forms, byte-identical to round 5. Both blocks also carry 2 allowed shapes: the documented rethrow and a plain try/finally with no control transfer.
